campaign_metadata.title: The Beregost Time Loop
campaign_metadata.asymmetric_knowledge_rule: Only the 5 PCs retain memories and progression across resets. All NPCs, monsters, and celestials reset identically each cycle.
campaign_metadata.progression_model: Milestone Level-Ups upon defeating Capstone Bosses + Soul-Imprinted Blessings + Air Genie Wish Boons.

previous_campaign_continuity.arcanist_battery: The party previously released the Angel and Devil who were bound as a dual-planar magical battery for a corrupt arcanist. Breaking the conduits triggered an Inversion Soul-Swap.
previous_campaign_continuity.player_recognition: The players recognize both entities from the prior campaign, but do not realize their physical bodies were swapped.
previous_campaign_continuity.angel_erratic_behavior: The players observed that the Angel has been doing strange, cruel, and unsettling things.
previous_campaign_continuity.rakshasa_cleanse_lie: The tiger-headed Rakshasa (as Aurelius) explains away the Angel's weird behavior by claiming the Angel was corrupted by the Arcanist's battery, and that the party must 'cleanse the Angel' by driving the Crucible Charm into the horned fiend in the north woods.

inner_red_loop.name: Aerial Flight Limit (Inner Red Loop)
inner_red_loop.travel_mode: Flight (Zephyr Gryphon / Fly Spells / Giant Eagle)
inner_red_loop.description: The maximum radius reachable by air from Beregost before high-altitude solar exposure and violent thermal updrafts strip all shade and force mounts/flyers down (DC 16 Con save or plummet from heat shock). Beyond noon, flight is strictly impossible.

outer_red_loop.name: On-Foot Travel Limit (Outer Red Loop)
outer_red_loop.travel_mode: Ground Foot (60m/hex) or Mounted (30m/hex) utilizing rock shade, forest canopy, and canyon corridors
outer_red_loop.description: The absolute maximum radius party members can push on foot/mount after dismounting before 15:00 surface heat (175°F, 10d6 Fire/round in the open) triggers atmospheric conflagration, forcing everyone into underground bunker shelters. Outdoor travel beyond 15:00 is lethal.

key_locations.name: Beregost (Central Hub)
key_locations.desc: Starting ground zero at 06:00. Feldepost Inn, Town Square Clocktower, Baker Tobias, Little Maya, Captain Rebecca. Center of the 12-hour time loop.

key_locations.name: Port Watchtower & Docks
key_locations.desc: Coastal watchtower, fishing piers, sand dunes. West terminus of stone highway. Raiders prepare attack.

key_locations.name: Commodore (Beached Caravel)
key_locations.desc: Stranded caravel on flats. Raiders attack at 09:30. Abyssal anchor chains bind Tempest Lord Otheus (Storm Giant, CR 13, Boss 4) underwater!

key_locations.name: Ancient Weirwood Tree (Ash Grove)
key_locations.desc: Crash site of True Angel (in fiend's horned body). Druid perimeter circle. Smells of ozone, rain, and frankincense. Rejection pulse at 11:30.

key_locations.name: Dwarvenhold Mountain Stronghold
key_locations.desc: Dwarven mountain hold at eastern end of highway. Armed with heavy cold-iron grounding ballistas capable of tethering the White Dragon.

key_locations.name: White Dragon Glacier (Rimefang Lair)
key_locations.desc: Sub-zero blizzard peak. Lair of Adult White Dragon (CR 13, Boss 1). Slaying Rimefang frees the Air Genie Zephyrus and unlocks 1 Wish/loop!

key_locations.name: Headwater Mountain Lake
key_locations.desc: Mountain spring source of the southern river flowing past Beregost into the ocean.

key_locations.name: Sunken Desert Necropolis
key_locations.desc: Subterranean crypt of Mummy Lord Akh-en-Amon (CR 15, Boss 2). Contains golden tablets proving the Angel and Devil swapped physical bodies.

key_locations.name: The Sanctum (Chronomancy Spire)
key_locations.desc: Ancient Kaelen's arcane laboratory. Tuning fork for East Quarry Resonator crafted here at 17:15.

key_locations.name: East Quarry Foundries
key_locations.desc: Brass Solar Resonator array calibrated by Artificer Bram. Orbital weapon firing canyon-clearing beam at 13:00.

key_locations.name: South Aqueducts & Cisterns
key_locations.desc: Municipal drainage and deep water channels. Scalding 20,000-gallon purge triggered at 11:00 AM.

npc_directory.name: Tobias Miller
npc_directory.title: Master Baker
npc_directory.role: Beloved town baker whose warmth anchors the town's spirit.

schedule.act: Stoking oven, baking honey-currant solstice rolls.
Pacing anxiously; solstice yeast cart overdue from Coast Road.
Distributing warm rolls; notices divine hum in baking pans.
Shocked to see well water dropped 4 ft; draws murky water.
Charmed arsonists attempt to burn his grain and flour store!
Carries remaining bread sacks down to the Temple of Lathander crypts.
Distributing bread and fresh water to terrified families sheltering below.
Praying with Maya and the congregation as thermal hum shakes the floor.
Consumed in the reset.

npc_directory.default_fate: Suffocates in cellar at 15:15 trying to save his family baking journals from the burning bakery.
npc_directory.intervention: Retrieve delayed yeast cart on Coast Road at 07:00, or ambush arsonists behind granary at 12:05.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Hands over Subterranean Flour-Chute Key (leads into cisterns) and teaches Lathander Hearth Bread recipe (+5 Temp HP per loop).

npc_directory.name: Little Maya
npc_directory.title: Orphan Girl
npc_directory.role: 8-year-old orphan girl who observes more than anyone realizes.

schedule.act: Skipping by the well clutching carved wooden thrush.
Spots golden Deva slipping from abandoned house adjusting disguise!
Accidentally drops wooden thrush down the deep well; crying softly.
Weaving green clover bracelets for festival luck.
Hiding in shade from scorching 125°F heat.
Escorted down into the Temple catacombs by Sister Althea as church bells toll.
Sheltering in the deep catacombs clutching her clover bracelet beside Tobias.
Huddling against Sister Althea's robes in the inner sanctuary.
Vaporized in solar reset.

npc_directory.default_fate: Dies of heatstroke and asphyxiation inside overcrowded temple crypt at 15:45.
npc_directory.intervention: Use Mage Hand or climb well at 07:15 to recover thrush. Befriend her before 08:00.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Phase 1 Clue: Reveals Aurelius came from abandoned house on Cobbler's Lane with backward thumbs! Hands over clover bracelet.

npc_directory.name: Captain Rebecca Thorne
npc_directory.title: Town Guard Captain
npc_directory.role: Battle-tested veteran nursing an old war-knee, holding the peace.

schedule.act: Reviewing patrol roster and nursing aching knee.
Inspecting sentries and greeting early morning merchant wagons.
Settling merchant disputes; investigating fake wagon loss.
Receives forged dispatches from Vane; orders patrols away to quarry.
Sounding brass alarm bells as heat Metal effect begins.
Ordering all remaining civilians and militia to evacuate into the Temple crypts.
Guards the reinforced iron crypt gates of the Temple; safe below ground.
Stands watch over the huddled refugees as the stone walls tremble.
Incinerated at her guard post in reset.

npc_directory.default_fate: Suffers fatal third-degree burns at 15:30 holding the municipal bunker door shut against panic.
npc_directory.intervention: Expose Scribe Vane's forged dispatches at 10:15 before she sends patrols away.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Grants Municipal Armory Master Key (20 silvered bolts, heavy shields) and orders guards to escort civilians early.

npc_directory.name: Artificer Bram Copperwheel
npc_directory.title: Chief Horologist
npc_directory.role: Master mechanic obsessed with the stopped municipal clock.

schedule.act: Inspecting newly chiming municipal clock (was jammed at 5:59 AM until the bone was removed).
Discovers strange chronocite residue gumming the pendulum escapement.
Rushed to East Quarry (13,9) by council to align the brass Solar Resonator.
⚠️ Calibrates Resonator; array fires 10d10 radiant test beam down canyon!
🔥 Trapped as brass mirrors warp and melt in extreme heat.
💥 Obliterated in cataclysm.

npc_directory.default_fate: Vaporized when the 40-foot brass resonator array catastrophically overloads at 13:00.
npc_directory.intervention: Inspect clocktower with him at 06:30. Give him Chronocite fragment to examine.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Reveals Resonator Disarm Code (7-3-9-1) to disable orbital beam, and gives Cold-Iron Escapement Pins.

npc_directory.name: Old Granny Morwen
npc_directory.title: Blind Apothecary
npc_directory.role: Blind herbalist with superhuman olfactory and hearing senses.

schedule.act: Grinding wintermint and mountain lichen.
Sniffs morning air: remarks on ozone and frankincense from North Forest.
Brewing cooling burn draughts as temperature crosses 95°F.
Barricading shutters against scorching dust winds.
Packs medical herbs and cooling draughts into handcart; moves to Temple crypts.
Treating scorched citizens with cooling salves in the crypt sanctuary.
Administering willowbark tea to calm panic as subterranean heat creeps in.
Reset to her mortar.

npc_directory.default_fate: Her herb drying racks ignite at 14:15, suffocating her in the root cellar.
npc_directory.intervention: Deliver deep well water at 08:00 or cast Create Water on her roof at 13:00.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Brews Frost-Lichen Drought (gives 2 hours of heat immunity up to 140°F). Confirms Angel's frankincense scent.

npc_directory.name: Elorion the Weeping Bard
npc_directory.title: Catatonic Minstrel
npc_directory.role: Traumatized traveling bard haunted by the Singing Devil's song.

schedule.act: Catatonic in corner, weeping, scratching sheet music into tabletop.
Humming eerie celestial counter-melodies between sobs.
Bleeding from ears as divine static hums through metal cutlery.
Wanders in a trance toward the sound of Lathander's church bells.
Led into the crypts by Sister Althea; curls near the ancient martyr tomb.
Softly humming celestial harmonies that soothe frightened children.
Voice rises into a pure, haunting counter-resonance against the shaking earth.
Reset.

npc_directory.default_fate: Mind breaks completely from psychic resonance at 11:30; dies in tavern conflagration.
npc_directory.intervention: Cast Lesser Restoration or make DC 14 Performance / Persuasion check before 09:00 to transcribe his music.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Hymn of the Shattered Choir: Grants party Advantage on saves vs Devil's hypnosis and counters fiendish charm!

npc_directory.name: Scribe Vane
npc_directory.title: Municipal Clerk & Archivist
npc_directory.role: Nervous, bureaucratic archivist charmed by the Rakshasa.

schedule.act: Stamping solstice trade manifests and ledger receipts.
⚠️ Meets Aurelius; charmed by Rakshasa's mental dominate magic.
Falsifying supply manifests; hiding cold-iron stockpiles.
Issues forged dispatches ordering guards away from granary.
⚠️ Locks town water sluices, preventing cistern fire-fighting.
🔥 Locked inside stone vault, clutching moneybags as metal melts.
💥 Vaporized.

npc_directory.default_fate: Vault seals shut from thermal expansion; suffocates clutching stolen council gold at 15:30.
npc_directory.intervention: Cast Dispel Magic or Protection from Evil on him before 10:00 to break the Rakshasa's charm.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Confesses everything! Hands over Municipal Safe Combination (12-44-09) and Sluice Gate Control Key.

npc_directory.name: Sister Althea
npc_directory.title: High Priestess of Lathander
npc_directory.role: Devoted solar priestess who mistakes the heat for divine blessing.

schedule.act: Leading choral morning prayers to Lathander, the Morninglord.
Approached by Aurelius; Aurelius refuses to step on consecrated stone.
Rejoicing over 'divine warmth' as heat hits 95°F.
Horrified as holy stained glass cracks from heat; realizes sun is corrupt.
Throws open the consecrated deep stone catacombs as emergency civilian blast shelter.
Leading prayers for all gathered townsfolk; burning spell slots to soothe heat exhaustion.
Consecrating the inner vault as bedrock begins to groan under extreme pressure.
Shielding sobbing children with radiant aura as 1d10 subterranean heat begins.
Vaporized alongside the town in the final solar reset.

npc_directory.default_fate: Exhausts spell slots and collapses from heat stroke in crypt at 16:15.
npc_directory.intervention: Present evidence of temporal corruption (stopped clock or sulfur bone) before 09:00.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Dawn's Aegis Boon (1/day advantage on death saves) and 2 scrolls of Protection from Energy (Fire).

npc_directory.name: Taerom Thunderhammer
npc_directory.title: Master Blacksmith
npc_directory.role: Stalwart dwarven expatriate master smith.

schedule.act: Stoking forge fires; shaping iron horseshoes.
Shoeing merchant draft horses and checking wagon axles.
Baffled as anvil rings with divine static; metal sparks spontaneously.
Forced to douse hearth as heat Metal effect makes tools burn hands.
Convinced by Thorne to abandon the forge; douses coal with water.
Arrives at Temple crypts carrying iron reinforcing beams.
Using cold iron wedges to reinforce the ancient stone crypt vault.
Bracing the central stone archway with his massive shoulders.
Reset to the hearth.

npc_directory.default_fate: Coal bunker ignites at 15:20; smothered under collapsing smithy chimney.
npc_directory.intervention: Warn him to wet the coal cellar before 10:00; help him secure cold-iron reserves.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Hands over 2 Cold-Iron Ballista Harpoon Heads for Dwarvenhold, and forges Cold-Iron Weapon Coatings.

npc_directory.name: Barnaby Feldepost
npc_directory.title: Innkeeper & Smuggler
npc_directory.role: Gruff, pragmatic tavernkeeper who knows every secret cellar in town.

schedule.act: Wiping counter, setting breakfast tables, counting yesterday's coin.
Serving hot cider and Tobias's fresh rolls to patrons.
Padding cold ale kegs with wet straw to prevent spoiling.
Barricading tavern doors as panicked crowds rush inside.
Realizes timber inn will catch fire; organizes evacuation down Temple Walk.
Arrives at Temple crypts guiding frightened patrons and tavern scullery staff.
Helping Sister Althea organize civilian triage in the south catacombs.
Shoring up crypt entrance timbers alongside Kaelen.
Consumed in the reset.

npc_directory.default_fate: Suffocates in cellar at 15:40 after timber beams collapse and seal the escape hatch.
npc_directory.intervention: Help him brace cellar trapdoor and clear tunnel entrance at 08:30.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Shows party Old Smugglers' Tunnel in wine cellar, enabling underground travel to aqueducts during 15:00 heat!

npc_directory.name: Garrick the Fence
npc_directory.title: Black Market Dealer
npc_directory.role: Shady dealer selling contraband, lockpicks, and arcane curios.

schedule.act: Counting lockpicks and illicit alchemist's fire vials.
Selling illegal municipal key blanks to travelers.
Inspecting stolen brass chronocite cylinder bought from quarry rogue.
⚠️ Ambushed and assassinated by Rakshasa's charmed thugs to silence him!
🔥 Corpse burned in conflagration.
💥 Obliterated.

npc_directory.default_fate: Murdered at 11:15 in Cobbler's Lane by charmed thugs; body looted of chronocite cylinder.
npc_directory.intervention: Ambush the thugs in Cobbler's Lane at 11:10 and save his life.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Hands over Chronocite Skeleton Key (opens all municipal locks) and Chronocite Cylinder.

npc_directory.name: Young Kaelen
npc_directory.title: Apprentice Chronomancer
npc_directory.role: Brilliant young apprentice whose future self built the Sanctum.

schedule.act: Staring in disbelief at whirling chronomancy hourglasses.
Measuring tachyonic ripples spreading from the Town Clocktower.
Taking dimensional readings; notices time dilation around party.
Terrified: his journal magically fills with handwriting from his future self!
Follows Barnaby's evacuation, carrying chronomancy sensors.
Sets up warding circles inside the deep stone catacombs.
Monitoring ambient tachyon pressure; insulated by deep bedrock.
Warns that subterranean bedrock is heating up; records final loop metrics.
Reset to Room #4.

npc_directory.default_fate: Mind burns out attempting to maintain a localized stasis field against 175°F heat.
npc_directory.intervention: Deliver Ancient Kaelen's tuning fork schematics from the Sanctum (14,13) before 10:00.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Unlocks Town Square Teleport Sigil (instant fast-travel between Beregost and the Sanctum once per loop).

npc_directory.name: Alderman Durlag Stonecrest
npc_directory.title: Merchant Councilman
npc_directory.role: Pompous, wealthy councilor manipulated into hoarding cold-iron.

schedule.act: Counting estate rents and dining on spiced tea.
Convinced by Aurelius to buy and impound all incoming cold-iron wagons.
Locking down 4 heavy wagons loaded with cold-iron ingots.
Refusing emergency release of wagons to militia.
Retreating into his private granite vault.
🔥 Vault air heats to 160°F; suffocates in greed.
💥 Obliterated.

npc_directory.default_fate: Suffocates in his private vault at 15:30 when the vault doors seize shut from heat expansion.
npc_directory.intervention: Expose the fake requisition contract at 08:15 before he signs the lockdown order.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Keeps cold-iron wagons open, granting militia cold-iron weapons (+1d6 damage vs Rakshasa & Fiends).

npc_directory.name: Corin the Swift
npc_directory.title: Rooftop Urchin Scout
npc_directory.role: 12-year-old agile orphan and Maya's protective older foster brother.

schedule.act: Leaping across slate shingles watching dawn break.
Watches through dusty skylight as Aurelius disguises himself!
Slipping through the crowd; can pickpocket Aurelius's Crucible Charm!
Stealing apples and dried meat for Maya.
Hiding in cool water reservoir.
Slips down through secret ossuary grate into the Temple crypts to find Maya.
Sitting beside Maya in the catacombs sharing dried apples.
Holding Maya's hand in the dark as deep bedrock superheats.
Reset to Clocktower roof.

npc_directory.default_fate: Burned on the cobblestones at 15:10 while frantically running to rescue Maya from the crypt.
npc_directory.intervention: Bribe him with 5 gold or food at 06:30 and assign him to tail Aurelius.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Pickpockets the Crucible Charm before Aurelius reaches the gate, disarming the trap before it starts!

npc_directory.name: Constable Renwick
npc_directory.title: North Gate Sentry
npc_directory.role: Dutiful gate sergeant who logs every traveler entering Beregost.

schedule.act: Winding gate winches to raise the heavy portcullis.
Logs Aurelius entering; notes in ledger: 'Traveler casts no shadow.'
Observing strange silver smoke rising from North Forest crater.
Charmed by forged dispatch; leaves gate unmanned.
Suffers heat exhaustion; helped off the ramparts by militia.
Carried down to Temple catacombs by Thorne's guards.
Resting on a stone pallet; recovering as Althea treats his burns.
Grabs his halberd, swearing to protect the children to the end.
Reset.

npc_directory.default_fate: Cooks inside heavy plate armor at gatehouse at 12:30; gate falls into chaos.
npc_directory.intervention: Inspect his 07:00 gate ledger and order him to remove heavy armor before 10:00.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Phase 1 Clue: Shadowless Deva. Gives party Gatehouse Alarm Horn (summons 6 militia reserves in combat).

npc_directory.name: Archdruid Faelan
npc_directory.title: High Elf Circle Leader
npc_directory.role: Protector of the ancient grove, mobilizing a lethal binding chant.

schedule.act: Awakened by violent celestial crash in the sacred grove.
Mobilizing druids with thorn barriers around the bleeding beast.
Chanting ancient earth tethers; beast shields druids from falling limbs.
⚠️ Unleashes Great Binding Rite; triggers Angel's Divine Rejection Pulse!
Reeling from psychic pulse; forest begins catching fire.
🔥 Forest incinerates; druids burn in sacred grove.
💥 Vaporized.

npc_directory.default_fate: Killed at 11:30 AM by the Angel's 70-damage Divine Rejection Pulse triggered by the binding rite.
npc_directory.intervention: Present evidence of the True Angel's holy nature before 11:00 AM.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Druids stand down; cast Mass Protection from Energy (Fire) and gift Weirwood Staff of Woodland Stride.

npc_directory.name: Druid Scout Sylvan
npc_directory.title: Circle Scout
npc_directory.role: Young scout who witnesses the True Angel's benevolence.

schedule.act: Tracking the smoking crater in the forest.
Shooting warning arrows at the horned beast.
Pinned under a burning weirwood log; beast burns own hand to save him!
Frantically arguing with Archdruid that the beast is not evil.
Knocked unconscious by 11:30 Rejection Pulse.
🔥 Perishes in wildfire.
💥 Obliterated.

npc_directory.default_fate: Knocked unconscious at 11:30 and dies in the forest conflagration.
npc_directory.intervention: Heal him at 09:15 when the log falls; he becomes an eyewitness proving the body swap.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Convinces Archdruid Faelan immediately, bypassing the entire 11:30 druid battle!

npc_directory.name: The True Angel (In Fiend's Body)
npc_directory.title: Benevolent Celestial Entity
npc_directory.role: The true divine angel trapped in a monstrous horned fiend body.

schedule.act: Crash-lands in crater; bleeding luminescent silver-white vapor.
Erects non-lethal crystalline barrier; mutters Celestial prayers.
Shields Druid Scout Sylvan from falling burning weirwood bough.
⚠️ Body rejects druid binding; triggers 70-dmg Divine Rejection Pulse.
Exhausted, silver vapor dimming; weeping for Beregost.
🔥 Body incinerated; celestial soul pulled into time vortex.
💥 Reset snaps entity back to 06:00 crash.

npc_directory.default_fate: Executed by players (if tricked by Crucible Charm) or killed in the 15:00 forest inferno.
npc_directory.intervention: Speak Celestial or refuse to attack; show the sulfur bone anchor fragment.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Bestows Aegis of the Host (+2 to all saving throws vs radiant/fire) and reveals true loop break condition.

npc_directory.name: Thane Torvald Ironbreaker
npc_directory.title: Dwarvenhold Fortress Ruler
npc_directory.role: Gruff, paranoid dwarven king holding the mountain highway pass.

schedule.act: Reviewing mineral mining reports and cold-iron stores.
Orders mountain gatehouse sealed against surface heat.
Debates whether to intervene in dragon activity to the east.
Watches glacial ice melt down Frostpeak; orders blast doors sealed.
Fortress blast doors withstand surface heat, but sulfur fumes seep in.
💥 Mountain peak shattered in solar detonation.

npc_directory.default_fate: Seals himself in deep mines; mountain is obliterated in 17:59 detonation.
npc_directory.intervention: Arrive with Taerom's letter of recommendation before 10:00 AM.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Authorizes deployment of Cold-Iron Grounding Ballistas against Boss 1 (Adult White Dragon).

npc_directory.name: Forge-Master Brenda Deepforge
npc_directory.title: Chief Ballista Engineer
npc_directory.role: Dwarven siege engineer operating the mountain grounding ballistas.

schedule.act: Calibrating tension springs on three massive mountain ballistas.
Tracking White Dragon circling peak through brass spyglass.
Lacks heavy cold-iron harpoon tips to pierce dragon scales.
Cooling ballista winches with mountain snowmelt.
Retreating underground as surface rock glows red-hot.
💥 Vaporized.

npc_directory.default_fate: Ballistas fail to fire due to lack of cold-iron harpoon heads; dragon remains airborne.
npc_directory.intervention: Deliver Thunderhammer's cold-iron ballista tips from town before 10:30 AM.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Auto-grounds the White Dragon on round 1 of the Boss 1 encounter, nullifying its 80ft fly speed!

npc_directory.name: Zephyrus the Cloud-Lord
npc_directory.title: Air Genie of the Frostpeak
npc_directory.role: Noble Air Genie imprisoned in permafrost beneath the White Dragon's hoard.

schedule.act: Frozen in solid permafrost vault beneath Rimefang's hoard.
Vault ice begins sweating under solar heat.
Ice bridge collapses; vault crushed under falling glacier.
💥 Vaporized.

npc_directory.default_fate: Remains frozen until crushed when the glacier collapses into the valley at 15:00.
npc_directory.intervention: Slay Adult White Dragon (Rimefang) and shatter ice vault before 12:00 PM.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: UNLEASHES 1 ACTIVE WISH PER LOOP for the entire campaign: grants full party resistance to a chosen element!

npc_directory.name: Rimefang
npc_directory.title: Adult White Dragon (Boss 1)
npc_directory.role: CR 13 Capstone Boss for Level 7 party. Hoards the Genie vault.

schedule.act: Sleeping atop frozen treasure mounds in blizzard howl.
Stirs from sleep; sniffs unusual thermal updrafts in the air.
Takes flight; circles peak at 80ft fly speed hunting mountain goats.
Agitated as glacial ice sweats meltwater from solar heat.
Exposed to direct solar beam; scales steam in heat.
Roars in agony as glacier melts into mudslides.
💥 Vaporized.

npc_directory.default_fate: Wipes unprepared parties with Freezing Fog + 80ft aerial kiting; killed when grounded.
npc_directory.intervention: Ground using Pike's halberd (Long Arm of the Law) or Dwarvenhold ballistas. Hit with Ivan's Fire Tome.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Milestone Level-Up to Level 8! Frees Djinni Zephyrus.

npc_directory.name: Zahir the Dune-Strider
npc_directory.title: Desert Hermit & Scout
npc_directory.role: Weathered nomad who knows the secret entrances to the ancient necropolis.

schedule.act: Refilling waterskins in cool sandstone canyon shade.
Observing shifting sands; notes ancient tomb doorway emerging.
⚠️ Shifting desert winds uncover the secret stone stair to the tomb!
Forced into deep shaded cave as dune surface heat hits 130°F.
🔥 Sand turns molten; cave ceiling collapses.
💥 Glassed in nuclear heat.

npc_directory.default_fate: Dies in cave collapse when extreme surface heat glasses the sand at 15:00.
npc_directory.intervention: Trade fresh honey rolls from Tobias or water from Beregost for his tomb chart at 07:30.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Tomb Map: Bypasses 3 lethal sand-quicksand traps and avoids dust mephit ambush.

npc_directory.name: Akh-en-Amon
npc_directory.title: Mummy Lord (Boss 2)
npc_directory.role: CR 15 Undead Boss for Level 8-9 party. Guards the body-swap scripture.

schedule.act: Slumbering inside sealed alabaster sarcophagus in cool subterranean crypt.
Stirs as desert winds uncover crypt entrance above.
Summons Dust Stalkers and Insect Plague to patrol corridors.
Chamber glows with necrotic warding runes.
Crypt roof cracks under molten surface heat.
💥 Vaporized in solar cataclysm.

npc_directory.default_fate: Wipes parties with Dread Glare + Mummy Rot unless burned with fire and protected by Scarab.
npc_directory.intervention: Exploit Fire Vulnerability (Ivan's Tome) and smash Canopic Heart stored in Chronocite urn.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Milestone Level-Up to Level 10! Golden Tablets prove Angel/Devil body swap ritual.

npc_directory.name: Commodore Alistair Vance
npc_directory.title: Master of the Sea Maiden
npc_directory.role: Stranded naval commander defending his beached flagship.

schedule.act: Surveying beached caravel hull on morning low-tide flats.
Directing crew to repair rudder and board up hull breaches.
⚠️ Sahuagin coastal raiders assault caravel; light starfire fuse!
💥 Starfire fuse explodes hull unless defused by party!
Surviving sailors take cover under keel from boiling spray.
🔥 Ocean water steams at 150°F; crew scalded.
💥 Vaporized.

npc_directory.default_fate: Killed in the 09:45 starfire explosion on the ship's lower deck.
npc_directory.intervention: Arrive before 09:30 AM; defeat raiders and defuse the starfire fuse on the hull flank.
npc_directory.persistent_reward: Shows party the Abyssal Winch Mechanism holding the underwater chains binding the Storm Giant.

npc_directory.name: Tempest Lord Otheus
npc_directory.title: Storm Giant (Boss 4 / Ultimate Ally)
npc_directory.role: CR 13 Empowered Storm Giant bound in abyssal anchor chains underwater.

schedule.act: Bound by glowing black abyssal chains in deep trench beneath caravel.
Thrashes in chains as raider starfire bomb explodes above.
Abyssal chains superheat; screams shake coastal bluffs with thunder.

Perched on high bluffs overlooking the Weirwood entrance; urges party north and monitors Circle of the Green Wreath.
Lurks invisible in tree branches; watches Druids corner the True Angel (Horned Fiend) with malicious anticipation.
💥 Witnesses the 11:30 AM soul detonation obliterate the grove; smiles coldly and slips away via Plane Shift.

npc_directory.name: Old Jonas the Rhymer
npc_directory.title: The Solstice Prophet
npc_directory.role: Haggard prophet wrapped in a patched quilt reciting the 12-line Solstice prophecy.
npc_directory.poem:
With six chimes the belfry wakes,
The choir sings, the mountain shakes.

Slay the white wyrm for his chart,
To claim a wish of frozen heart.

South: sunken tombs of sand reveal
Two traded souls a touch must heal.

North: pierce the striped fiend’s holy guise,
His true name binds his web of lies.

West: break the deep-sea giant’s chain,
To drag the singing wings to rain.

Four corners mend the falling sun,
Or dawn resets what dusk begun.

schedule.act: Sitting against the well wrapped in a patched quilt, chanting the 12-line Solstice Doom Prophecy to unimpressed festival-goers.
Warning Tobias that sweetbreads won't soothe a falling sky; Tobias chuckles and gifts him a warm roll.
Pointing north and east as divine static hums through cobblestones: 'The wyrm sleeps, the fiend smiles!'
Shivering in terror as the northern explosion rumbles: 'The choir approaches!'
Walking slowly toward the Temple of Lathander, clutching his patched quilt.
Sheltering in the subterranean crypts, softly whispering the four stanzas to trembling children.
Looking upward as celestial singing echoes down the stone stairs: 'Six chimes! The belfry wakes!'
Consumed in the solar reset alongside the town.

bootstrap_paradox.concept: Ontological / Bootstrap Paradox (The party is the creator of the time loop)
bootstrap_paradox.timeline_prime: In the original un-looped timeline, Beregost was vaporized at 18:00 with zero warning. In their dying moments beneath the temple, the party and True Angel used the Chronocite Bone to perform an emergency temporal translocation rite.
bootstrap_paradox.time_jump: The party jumped back to 05:45 AM, 15 minutes before sunrise, intending to freeze or buffer the solar beam.
bootstrap_paradox.clocktower_mistake: At 05:59 AM, the party jammed the Chronocite Bone into the Grand Horological Escapement Mechanism in the Beregost Clocktower. When the clock struck 06:00:00 AM, it locked the valley into a 12-hour closed causal loop.
bootstrap_paradox.memory_loss: The quantum temporal shockwave wiped the party's short-term memory of the jump, leaving them waking up at 06:00 clutching the sulfur bone.
bootstrap_paradox.resolution: Defeating the Singing Devil, reversing the swap, and physically sundering the Chronocite Bone from the clock gears before 18:00 breaks the loop permanently.

dawn_monologue.usage: To be read aloud by the DM at 06:00 AM in Session 1 when the clock unjams, and re-read verbatim at 06:00 AM on every loop reset.
dawn_monologue.text:
You hear a sharp, heavy CLACK as the clock ticks forward to 6:00 AM. A great bronze bell strikes—GONG. In your hand, the pale bone that jammed the mechanism crumbles, dissolving into a fine gray dust that slips through your fingers.
The morning air is crisp and cool. The town square down below you stirs to life: a baker emerges with a steaming tray of honey-currant rolls, a little girl skips past the well tossing a carved wooden thrush into the air, a haggard old man sits up, wrapped in a patched quilt, and merchants unfurl colorful festival banners across the cobblestones.

Beyond the rooftops, the morning horizons stretch wide: to the north, crows scatter over the green forest canopy; to the east, snowy peaks glint white; to the south, ribbons of dust lift off desert dunes; and far to the west, low thunder rumbles over the sea.
It is dawn, and the sun sets in 12 hours.
Down in the square, a town guard shields her eyes, waving up at the belfry with a wide grin:
'Hey! You got the clock working! Thank you! Happy Solstice!'
