key_relics.desc: Preserved necrotic organ that siphons solar heat; grants the bearer complete immunity to desert solar burn (140°F) while held.

key_relics.name: Scarab Talisman of Sun-Warding
key_relics.desc: Wards against radiant damage (Resistance to Radiant) and allows reading ancient celestial hieroglyphs.

timed_hazards.desc: Cool Morning Sands. The entrance chute at Hex (14, 12) is stable and accessible via rope (DC 10 Athletics). Tomb interior is a cool 68°F shelter.
Thermal Sifting. Rising heat outside causes dune sand to pour into Room 1, creating quicksand sinkholes (DC 14 Dex save or restrained).
Midday Solar Seal. Entrance chute is choked with 15 feet of boiling 140°F sand. Entering requires digging (30 mins) or magical teleportation.
Necrotic Thermal Resonance. Suncophagus runes glow violet; all undead in the tomb gain +2 AC and regenerate 10 HP per round.

rooms.name: The Sifting Sand Descent & Chute
rooms.description: A narrow sandstone shaft drops 40 feet into a cool, shadowed antechamber. Piles of fine, dry sand spill from ceiling vents like continuous hourglasses.

monsters.name: Giant Dune Scorpion
monsters.desc: Burrowed beneath the sand drifts; strike with blindsight when vibrations are felt.

rooms.hazard: Quicksand Pit: A 15-foot wide depression in the center. Creatures stepping into it sink 2 feet per round (DC 14 Str/Dex check to pull free).
rooms.secrets: Cracked Bas-Relief: A glyph-carved wall depicts a solar priest separating two twin astral spirits with a crystal prism—early foreshadowing of the arcanist's soul battery.

rooms.name: Hall of Canopic Guardians & Scarab Pit
rooms.description: Flanked by eight imposing jackal-headed pillars, this vaulted hallway is lined with alcoves containing clay urns filled with dried bitumen and scarab husks.

monsters.name: Dust Mephit Swarm
monsters.desc: CR 1/2 scouts; use Blinding Breath to force Disadvantage on party.

monsters.name: Mummy Sentinels
monsters.desc: CR 3 Canopic Guardians. Rotting Fist inflicts Mummy Rot, Dread Glare paralyzes. Vulnerable to Fire!

rooms.hazard: Tripwire Scythe Trap: DC 15 Perception to spot; DC 14 Dex save or takes 3d8 slashing and DC 13 Con save against mummy rot infection.
rooms.secrets: Canopic Urn of Breath: Contains a preserved lung that grants water breathing and immunity to suffocation for 1 hour when inhaled.

rooms.name: Embalming Hall of the Solar Priest (Tablet Archive)
rooms.description: A stone embalming table stained with ancient unguents sits beneath a vaulted ceiling carved with astrological alignments. Stone pedestals hold bronze-bound slate tablets.

monsters.name: Galeb Duhr Elder
monsters.desc: Bound as a stone ward by the ancient dynasty; attacks anyone attempting to lift the tablets without speaking the solar glyph.

rooms.hazard: Solar Rune Glyph: Stepping on the dais without speaking the glyph triggers a 4d10 radiant detonation (DC 15 Dex save for half).
rooms.secrets: ⭐ Inversion Swap Tablets: Discovered here! Translating the runes reveals: 'When the celestial and the fiend are bound within the twin crucibles, the spirit flits across the silver bridge—the angel wears the horned crown, while the fiend weeps behind the halo.' This is the party's critical breakthrough!

rooms.name: The Suncophagus Vault of Akh-en-Amon
rooms.description: A massive tiered sanctum dominated by a golden sarcophagus surrounded by four blazing braziers. Ghostly heat ripples distort the air, and necrotic whispers echo from the stone.

monsters.name: Mummy Lord (Akh-en-Amon)
monsters.desc: CR 15 Legendary Boss. Channels Dreadful Glare, Channel Negative Energy, and Rotting Fist.

rooms.hazard: Solar Fire Braziers: Four braziers feed the Mummy Lord's magic immunity. Extinguishing each brazier (DC 14 Athletics or water spell) strips 25 max HP from the boss.
rooms.secrets: Canopic Heart of Akh-en-Amon: Sits inside the sarcophagus. Absorbing it grants total immunity to extreme heat up to 18:00 PM.

dungeons.name: The Glacial Chasm & Rimefang's Frost Vault
dungeons.theme: Sub-Zero Glacial Crevasse & Ancient Dragon Lair
dungeons.overview: Perched on the high eastern peaks of Mount Rime lies a yawning chasm of blue glacial ice. Inside sleeps Rimefang, the ancient white dragon whose presence maintains the sub-zero microclimate. Trapped in a block of perpetual ice within the deepest vault is Djinni Zephyrus, whose rescue unlocks 4x aerial flight across the entire valley.

key_relics.name: Rime-Anchor Harpoon
key_relics.desc: Adamantine whaling harpoon forged from meteor iron; when driven into Rimefang, pins the dragon to the ground for 3 rounds, removing flight.

key_relics.name: Zephyrus's Whistle (Rescue)
key_relics.desc: Freeing Djinni Zephyrus rewards the party with four Zephyr Gryphon mounts, cutting travel time across all hexes to 15 minutes.

key_relics.name: Drake-Bane Censer
key_relics.desc: Emits sulfurous smoke that imposes disadvantage on dragon breath recharge rolls.

timed_hazards.desc: The Glacial Slumber. Rimefang is asleep atop the ice hoard. Stealth checks have advantage. Temperature is -15°F (requires cold gear or DC 12 Con save every hour).
The Morning Hunt. Rimefang takes flight circling the peak. The lair is guarded by the Winter Wolf pack. High altitude downdrafts.
Thermal Creep & Bridge Collapse. Valley heat begins warping the outer ice bridge. Crossing requires DC 15 Acrobatics or falls 80 ft into the crevasse.
Glacial Melting & Icicle Barrage. Ceiling melts and rains 10-foot razor icicles (DC 14 Dex save or 4d6 piercing/cold damage every 10 minutes).

rooms.name: The Slick Glissade & Frost Shelf
rooms.description: A steep slope of sheer blue ice descends 60 feet into the mountain's frozen belly. Howling winds funnel freezing mist through the entrance.

monsters.name: Giant Frost Spider
monsters.desc: Cling to translucent ice stalactites above; drop down to web climbing climbers.

rooms.hazard: Slick Surface: Moving faster than half speed requires DC 13 Acrobatics or slip and slide 30 feet down the slope, taking 2d6 bludgeoning.
rooms.secrets: Frozen Mountaineer: An adventurer frozen in the wall clutches 3 vials of Potion of Cold Resistance and climber's crampons.

rooms.name: The Bottomless Crevasse & Icicle Bridge
rooms.description: A sheer 200-foot fissure spans the cavern floor. A single arch of jagged ice bridges the gap, suspended over howling black depths.

monsters.name: Winter Wolf Pack Leader
monsters.desc: Prowl the far landing; coordinate breath attacks to blast party members off the bridge.

rooms.hazard: Collapsing Ice Span: At 12:00 PM or after taking 20+ fire damage, the bridge cracks and shatters. Flying or grappling hooks required.
rooms.secrets: Chasm Niche: A small alcove 30 feet down the crevasse wall hides the frozen skeleton of a dragon hunter clutching the Drake-Bane Censer.

rooms.name: Frozen Trophy Gallery & Yeti Den
rooms.description: Dozens of creatures—frost giants, dwarven miners, and a mammoth—are frozen solid in posture of terror like macabre ice sculptures.

monsters.name: Abominable Yeti of Frostpeak
monsters.desc: CR 9 guardian brute; uses Chilling Gaze and clubbing slams to defend the inner sanctum.

rooms.hazard: Freezing Mist Geyser: Every 2 rounds, a vent blasts 20-foot freezing steam (DC 14 Con save or 3d6 cold and paralyzed for 1 round).
rooms.secrets: Dwarven Runestone: Embedded in the ice floor; teaches the command word 'Khazad-Mor' to pacify the sentinel at Hex (14,7).

rooms.name: Djinni Zephyrus's Cryo-Vault & Dragon Hoard
rooms.description: A vast domed cavern carpeted in silver coins, frozen gemstones, and dragon bones. In the center rises a 15-foot monolith of glowing glacial ice holding a trapped Djinni.

monsters.name: Adult White Dragon (Rimefang)
monsters.desc: CR 13 Legendary Boss. Cold breath (12d8 cold), Legendary Actions, frightful presence.

rooms.hazard: Lair Actions: Freezing fog heavily obscures the cavern; ice wall erupts separating party members; ceiling drops 3d10 icicles.
rooms.secrets: ⭐ Djinni Zephyrus Prison: Dealing 50 fire damage or striking the block with the Rime-Anchor Harpoon shatters the ice! Zephyrus bows and summons four Zephyr Gryphons for the party.

dungeons.name: The Mirage Pavilion & Illusion Maze
dungeons.overview: Hidden within the jagged northern bluffs behind shimmering heat mirages sits the opulent extradimensional silk pavilion of Lord Ravana, the tiger-headed Rakshasa. While the valley swelters, Ravana reclines in magical luxury, sipping chilled wine and reviewing the corrupt arcanist's battery notes.

key_relics.name: The Arcanist's Resonance Ledger
key_relics.desc: Written in cipher; details the exact resonance frequencies of the Clocktower battery and proves Aurelius orchestrated the loop.

key_relics.name: Blessed Quiver of Radiant Piercing
key_relics.desc: Arrows fired from this quiver ignore the Rakshasa's Limited Magic Immunity and deal an extra 2d8 radiant damage.

key_relics.name: Inquisitive Monocle of Truth
key_relics.desc: Pierces the Rakshasa's Deva disguise and reveals his true tiger face, backwards hands, and illusions.

timed_hazards.desc: The Grand Masquerade. Aurelius is away roaming the valley in Deva form deceiving travelers. Pavilion is sealed by a DC 20 illusion veil.
The Extradimensional Siesta. Ravana rests inside the pavilion with his charmed retinue. The illusion maze is fully active.
Contingency Evacuation. Ravana packs the pavilion and teleports toward the clocktower to oversee the sunset cataclysm.
Abandoned Illusion Husk. The pavilion collapses into an arcane vortex, dealing 8d8 force damage to anyone inside.

rooms.name: The Shimmering Mirage Boundary
rooms.description: A curtain of wavering heat and rippling silk obscures the entrance. Stepping through feels like plunging through warm liquid glass into an impossibly cool oasis.

monsters.name: Briarwood Displacer Beast
monsters.desc: Charmed pets of the Rakshasa; project displacement illusions 3 feet away.

rooms.hazard: Phantasmal Veil: DC 18 Investigation check or True Seeing required to find the true entrance; failure causes party to wander in circles for 30 minutes.
rooms.secrets: Silk Banner: Embroidered with a tiger devouring a fallen sun; matches the heraldry in the Arcanist's ledger.

rooms.name: Corridor of Distorted Mirrors & Backwards Shadows
rooms.description: Polished silver mirrors line this winding corridor. Reflections don't match the viewer: characters see themselves with backwards hands and hollow glowing eyes.

monsters.name: Mirror Phantoms
monsters.desc: Illusionary copies of party members that copy their attacks with half damage.

rooms.hazard: Backwards-Hand Glyph: Touching a mirror triggers DC 16 Wis save or becomes Charmed by the Rakshasa for 1 hour, believing he is a benevolent archangel.
rooms.secrets: Cracked Mirror Niche: Behind the third mirror lies the Inquisitive Monocle of Truth in a velvet-lined rosewood box.

rooms.name: The Opulent Silk Divan & Feasting Salon
rooms.description: Plush crimson velvet carpets, gold-embroidered silk cushions, and tables groaning with iced grapes, spiced roast lamb, and chilled wine.

monsters.name: Charmed Elite Bodyguards
monsters.desc: Beregost town guards and mercenaries mind-controlled by Ravana's Dominate Person.

rooms.hazard: Drugged Spiced Wine: Consuming the banquet requires DC 16 Con save or falls into a magical slumber for 4 hours.
rooms.secrets: Silver Wine Flagon: Pours endless chilled Elverquisst wine (+10 temp HP per cup, 1/day).

rooms.name: The Arcanist's Resonance Sanctum
rooms.description: An intimate study lined with brass instruments, floating star charts, and the Arcanist's Resonance Ledger sitting atop an obsidian reading desk.

monsters.name: Lord Ravana / 'Aurelius'
monsters.desc: CR 13 Master Deceiver. Limited Magic Immunity (spells 6th level and lower cannot affect him), Claw curse, Dominate Person, Plane Shift.

rooms.hazard: Sanctum Leyline Ward: Spells of 6th level or lower cast within the room are instantly counterspelled by the chamber's resonant crystals.
rooms.secrets: ⭐ The Resonance Ledger: Contains the complete truth: Ravana built the loop to siphon the souls of Beregost into a divine battery. Details the Clocktower escapement override!

dungeons.name: The Beached Caravel & Abyssal Trenches
dungeons.theme: Beached War Galleon & Submerged Abyssal Trench
dungeons.overview: Stranded in the treacherous western tidal flats lies 'The Commodore', an ancient 60-gun war caravel beached centuries ago. Beneath the hull, an abyssal trench drops into the deep sea, where the Storm Giant Otheus is bound to a sunken monolith by three adamantine anchor chains. Coastal raiders light a Starfire powder fuse at 09:30 AM; the party must arrive before 09:45 AM to disarm the bomb and liberate Otheus!

key_relics.name: Adamantine Bolt Cutters / Grounding Trident
key_relics.desc: Heavy reinforced tools that can snap Otheus's three binding anchor chains without triggering electrical feedback.

key_relics.name: Otheus's Storm Conch
key_relics.desc: Blowing the horn allows summoning the 17:30 hurricane supercell, dropping valley temperatures by 80°F and shielding against the orbital beam.

key_relics.name: Potion of Water Breathing (x4)
key_relics.desc: Found in the ship's apothecary chest; allows exploring the submerged trench without drowning.

timed_hazards.desc: Morning Low Tide. The caravel is surrounded by damp sand flats. Easy approach. Raiders preparing to loot the powder magazine.
🔥 STARFIRE FUSE BURNING! Raiders light the 15-minute fuse to 50 barrels of starfire powder. Party has exactly 15 minutes to reach hold and disarm!
💥 POWDER EXPLOSION (If Not Disarmed). Deals 100d6 fire damage, destroying the ship, killing Otheus, and locking the hurricane boon forever.
Boiling High Tide. Ocean water rushes back in, superheated by midday sun (120°F water deals 1d6 fire damage per round).

rooms.name: Weathered Upper Deck & Rigging
rooms.description: Rotting oak planks littered with rusted cannons and tattered sails. Coastal raiders man the forecastle with heavy repeating crossbows.

monsters.name: Sea Harpy Flight
monsters.desc: Roost in the crows-nest; use Luring Song to draw characters into the tidal mud.

monsters.name: Coastal Raider Marines
monsters.desc: Vicious looters defending the hatchway down to the hold.

rooms.hazard: Rotting Deck Planks: Stepping on marked spots requires DC 13 Dex save or collapse 15 feet down into the gun deck.
rooms.secrets: Captain's Log: Outlines how the raiders were hired by Scribe Vane to ensure the powder fuse is lit at 09:30 AM sharp.

rooms.name: Flooded Gun Deck & Starfire Powder Hold
rooms.description: Knee-deep seawater sloshes across cannonballs and shattered crates. At the far bulkhead, a hissing white-hot Starfire fuse burns down toward 50 powder kegs!

monsters.name: Sahuagin Baron & Warband
monsters.desc: CR 5 brute guarding the powder hold; uses Blood Frenzy to slaughter intruders.

rooms.hazard: 🔥 Ticking Fuse: 15 minutes on the clock! Requires DC 15 Sleight of Hand or water spell to snip/extinguish before detonation.
rooms.secrets: Ship's Apothecary Chest: Contains 4 Potions of Water Breathing and 2 Potions of Greater Healing.

rooms.name: Barnacle Trench & Kelp Chasm
rooms.description: Through a breach in the ship's keel, the ocean floor plunges 80 feet down into a dark trench filled with swaying golden kelp forests.

monsters.name: Kelp Forest Giant Octopus
monsters.desc: Camouflaged in the kelp; grapple swimmers and drag them down into the trench.

rooms.hazard: Riptide Undertow: Strong underwater currents force DC 14 Str (Athletics) checks every round to maintain position.
rooms.secrets: Sunken Chest: Locked iron strongbox holding the Grounding Rod Trident (+2 trident that absorbs lightning damage).

rooms.name: The Abyssal Anchor Vault (Otheus's Prison)
rooms.description: A subterranean sea cave flooded with crystalline brine. Chained to a colossal black basalt monolith is Tempest Lord Otheus, lightning crackling from his brow.

monsters.name: Tempest Lord Otheus (Storm Giant)
monsters.desc: CR 13 Titan. Bound by 3 chains; once freed, unleashes devastating lightning strikes and allies with the party!

rooms.hazard: Electrical Feedback Arcs: Striking the chains with non-adamantine weapons triggers 3d10 lightning back to the attacker.
rooms.secrets: ⭐ The Storm Pact: Freeing Otheus causes him to raise his great hammer: 'At the seventeenth bell, I shall summon the tempest of the ages!' Unlocks the 17:30 hurricane shield.

dungeons.name: The South Aqueducts & Cistern Catacombs
dungeons.theme: Subterranean Roman-Style Water Works & Safe Cisterns
dungeons.overview: Deep beneath the arid southern hills runs the ancient stone aqueduct system that supplies Beregost with freshwater. At 10:45 AM, the traitor Scribe Vane jams the master sluice gates and triggers a 20,000-gallon scalding industrial runoff flush at 11:00 AM. Preventing this sabotage provides clean water and unlocks the deep cisterns as a subterranean shelter for 100 town civilians!

key_relics.name: Master Sluice Key & Brass Wheel
key_relics.desc: Restores flow to town wells and allows flooding irrigation trenches to extinguish forest fires.

key_relics.name: Scribe Vane's Bribe Ledger
key_relics.desc: Written in Rakshasa script; incriminates Vane and unmasks the Deva Aurelius as the puppet master.

key_relics.name: The Safe Cistern Haven
key_relics.desc: Subterranean vaulted bunker that stays a safe 72°F through the 18:00 PM solar inferno, saving Maya, Tobias, and 100 refugees.

timed_hazards.desc: Normal Operation. Aqueducts flow with cool, crisp water. Easy navigation along maintenance stone catwalks.
⚠️ SLUICE GATE JAMMED! Scribe Vane drops iron wedges into the master cogwheel, cutting water to Beregost wells.
🌊 20,000-GALLON BOILING FLUSH! Scalding factory runoff flushes through Room 3 (4d10 fire/bludgeoning damage to anyone on catwalks).
Stagnant Poison Sludge. Water dries up and boils into toxic sulfur fumes (DC 13 Con save or poisoned each hour).

rooms.name: Primary Sluice Gate Control Hub
rooms.description: A vaulted circular chamber where four massive stone pipes converge. Giant iron valves and brass cogwheels control the flow of roaring river water.

monsters.name: Corrupted Cultist Saboteurs
monsters.desc: Mercenaries hired by Vane guarding the sluice levers with heavy pikes.

rooms.hazard: Sluice Wheel Wedge: An iron crowbar jams the main cog. Removing it requires DC 15 Athletics check or Dispel Magic on the grease runes.
rooms.secrets: Brass Gauge Board: Displays water levels across all 380 hexes; reveals subterranean pipes leading directly under the town square.

rooms.name: Scribe Vane's Hidden Archive Vault
rooms.description: A dry side alcove furnished with a portable writing desk, tallow candles, and iron scroll canisters sealed with purple wax.

monsters.name: Wererat Bodyguards
monsters.desc: Vane's shapeshifting couriers; ambush intruders using stealth and shortbows.

rooms.hazard: Poison Needle Lock: DC 16 Sleight of Hand to disarm; DC 14 Con save or 4d6 poison damage and blinded for 1 hour.
rooms.secrets: ⭐ Vane's Confession Scroll: Documents how Aurelius paid him 5,000 gp in platinum ingots to drain the town wells before noon.

rooms.name: The Scalding Runoff Flume
rooms.description: A narrow 5-foot stone catwalk suspended over a deep canal where industrial smelting runoff rushes south toward the salt marshes.

monsters.name: Marsh Will-o'-Wisp
monsters.desc: Hover over the boiling waters, attempting to shock characters off the narrow catwalk.

rooms.hazard: 11:00 AM Boiling Flush: A wall of 190°F water rushes through. Party must secure themselves to iron handrails (DC 14 Str save) or be swept away.
rooms.secrets: Submerged Grate: Leads to a hidden storage locker containing 2 Ring of Swimming and 500 gp in uncut gems.

rooms.name: The Deep Cistern Haven (Civilian Sanctuary)
rooms.description: An enormous underground reservoir supported by thirty Roman-style granite pillars. The water is cool, crystal-clear, and surrounded by dry stone galleries.

monsters.name: Veteran Kaelen's Recon Patrol
monsters.desc: Town watch veterans securing the safehouse; stand down if Rebecca's token is shown.

rooms.hazard: Ventilation Flap: Must be sealed at 15:00 PM to keep out external 175°F convective heat.
rooms.secrets: ⭐ The Solstice Ark: Can house 100 civilians in complete safety from the 18:00 PM wipeout! Tobias, Maya, and Rebecca can be guided here to survive.

dungeons.name: East Quarry & Resonator Foundries
dungeons.theme: Terraced Granite Quarry & Parabolic Brass Foundry
dungeons.overview: Carved into the granite foothills of the eastern mountain range is the East Quarry and high-temperature brass foundries. Here Artificer Bram was sent at 09:00 AM to tune the giant parabolic brass Solar Resonator. At 13:00 PM, the resonator misfires, blasting a 10d10 radiant beam that incinerates the workshop and kills Bram. Recalibrating the mirrors saves Bram and yields the True Seeing Quartz Lens!

key_relics.name: True Seeing Quartz Lens
key_relics.desc: Polished optical quartz lens harvested from the quarry caverns; pierces illusions and reveals Rakshasa's true form.

key_relics.name: Clockwork Gyroscope Stabilizer
key_relics.desc: Essential component required by Bram to repair the Clocktower escapement gear train.

key_relics.name: Molten Crucible Tongs
key_relics.desc: Enchanted forge tongs that allow handling white-hot Chronocite metal without taking fire damage.

timed_hazards.desc: Quarry Awake. Stonemasons and artificers cutting quartz slabs. Safe environment. Bram is still in Beregost.
Bram at Work. Bram arrives and attempts to calibrate the giant brass parabolic dish. Clockwork automatons begin overheating.
💥 10d10 RADIANT CANYON BLAST! Resonator dish fires stray solar beam across the canyon, vaporizing the workshop and killing Bram!
Molten Brass Meltdown. Mirrors liquefy into running pools of 2,000°F brass; lower terraces become impassable lava lakes.

rooms.name: Granite Amphitheater & Derrick Cranes
rooms.description: Massive step-terraces descend 120 feet into the earth. Heavy wooden derrick cranes swing giant stone blocks overhead on creaking iron cables.

monsters.name: Stone Giant Guardian
monsters.desc: CR 7 brute enraged by the deafening clockwork machinery; hurls 4d10 boulder rocks.

rooms.hazard: Snapping Derrick Cable: DC 14 Dex save or struck by swinging 2-ton granite block (4d10 bludgeoning and pinned).
rooms.secrets: Quarry Office Safe: Contains Bram's master toolset (+2 to checks using thieves' tools or tinker's tools) and 400 gp.

rooms.name: Quartz Crystal Grotto
rooms.description: A subterranean cavern glittering with 6-foot violet and clear optical quartz crystals that reflect torchlight into thousands of rainbows.

monsters.name: Prismatic Basilisk
monsters.desc: CR 3 reptilian hunters whose petrifying gaze is reflected across the quartz crystals (DC 12 Con save).

rooms.hazard: Blinding Crystal Glare: Direct radiant or light spells in this room cause a blinding flash (DC 14 Con save or Blinded for 1 minute).
rooms.secrets: ⭐ Flawless Quartz Core: Mining a sample (DC 13 Athletics or stonecunning) yields the True Seeing Quartz Lens!

rooms.name: Smelting Foundry & Crucible Floor
rooms.description: Massive blast furnaces roar with magical fire. Vats of boiling brass and copper bubble violently as clockwork servitors scurry between gantries.

monsters.name: Overheated Clockwork Automatons
monsters.desc: Constructs suffering heat madness; vent 2d8 fire steam upon death.

rooms.hazard: Molten Splash: Stepping off metal gantries deals 5d10 fire damage from bubbling brass pools.
rooms.secrets: Artificer's Cooling Wand: Wand of Pyrotechnics with 7 charges, capable of instantly cooling superheated metal.

rooms.name: Solar Resonator Firing Platform
rooms.description: A 40-foot polished parabolic brass mirror aimed at the sky. Giant brass gears tick loudly as the countdown approaches 13:00 PM!

monsters.name: Greater Air Elemental
monsters.desc: Summoned by thermal convection; whips gale winds across the platform.

rooms.hazard: 13:00 PM Countdown: Disarming the mirror alignment gears requires DC 15 Tinker's Tools or DC 16 Arcana check before 13:00 PM.
rooms.secrets: ⭐ Bram's Gratitude: Saving Bram from the 13:00 explosion earns his absolute loyalty: 'Meet me at the clocktower at 17:00—I'll hold the escapement open!'

dungeons.name: The Chronomancy Spire (The Sanctum)
dungeons.theme: Floating Chronocite Spire & Temporal Rift Laboratory
dungeons.overview: Hovering above the southeastern badlands where past, present, and future timelines overlap sits the Chronomancy Spire. Here Ancient Kaelen—a temporal echo of the town watch veteran—works tirelessly in an accelerated time chamber to forge the Chronomancy Tuning Fork. Entering the spire requires navigating fluctuating Haste and Slow fields.

key_relics.name: Chronomancy Tuning Fork
key_relics.desc: Resonant temporal alloy fork forged by Ancient Kaelen at 17:15 PM; when struck in the Belfry, locks the time loop into phase.

key_relics.name: Ingot of Pure Chronocite
key_relics.desc: Rare metal that exists simultaneously in yesterday, today, and tomorrow; bypasses temporal degradation.

key_relics.name: Paradox Scroll of Unwritten Loops
key_relics.desc: Allows players to ask the DM 3 questions about future loop resets and receive truthful answers.

timed_hazards.desc: Temporal Fog. The spire is out of phase; DC 16 Arcana check required to locate the ethereal entry portal.
Time Flux Fields. Rooms cycle between Haste (+2 AC, extra action) and Slow (-2 AC, half speed) on initiative count 20.
Paradox Incursions. Time Wraiths spawn from dimensional rifts, draining 1d6 Strength with each necrotic touch.
⭐ THE TUNING FORK CHIME! Ancient Kaelen finishes forging the Tuning Fork and hands it to the party moments before the sky turns white.

rooms.name: The Astrolabe Antechamber
rooms.description: Concentric brass rings 30 feet tall spin in opposite directions around a levitating glass sphere. Gravity is subjective; walls are walkable.

monsters.name: Time Wraith Echoes
monsters.desc: Ghostly echoes of party members who died in previous loops; phase through solid glass.

rooms.hazard: Subjective Gravity: Moving between ceiling and floor requires DC 12 Wis check; failure causes a 20-foot fall into the gear train (2d6 bludgeoning).
rooms.secrets: Brass Astrolabe Register: Displays the current loop number and tracks how many total resets the party has experienced.

rooms.name: The Paradox Archive of Lost Loops
rooms.description: Thousands of illuminated parchment scrolls hover in midair like fluttering butterflies. Each records the transcript of a different failed timeline.

monsters.name: Chronal Golem Guardian
monsters.desc: Constructs of glass and ticking gears; immune to all spells of 4th level or lower.

rooms.hazard: Temporal Memory Shock: Reading an echo scroll requires DC 14 Int save or take 3d8 psychic damage from witnessing your own death.
rooms.secrets: ⭐ The Master Transcript: Party discovers a scroll detailing their victory conditions: 'Four relics to pierce the four cardinal seals, one tuning fork to align the bell.'

rooms.name: Chronocite Forge & Crucible
rooms.description: An anvil of frozen starlight glows with blue chronal fire. Ingot molds are filled with shifting mercury-like Chronocite metal.

monsters.name: Greater Air Elemental
monsters.desc: Fueling the temporal bellows with superheated storm winds.

rooms.hazard: Temporal Fire: Chronal forge flames age physical objects 10 years per round of contact.
rooms.secrets: Chronocite Bar: A 5 lb ingot of pure Chronocite that can be used to forge any item into a loop-persistent weapon!

rooms.name: The 17:15 Apex Spire & Anvil
rooms.description: A wind-scoured balcony looking out over the entire burning valley. An older, white-bearded version of Veteran Kaelen strikes a glowing tuning fork against the anvil.

monsters.name: Ancient Kaelen (Temporal Echo)
monsters.desc: Level 12 Eldritch Knight echo; guards the anvil until the party proves their identity.

rooms.hazard: 18:00 Sky Flash: At 17:55 PM, the sky turns blinding white; DC 15 Con save or permanently blinded if looking outward.
rooms.secrets: ⭐ The Chronomancy Tuning Fork: Handed directly to the party at 17:15 PM! 'Take it to the belfry before the final stroke! Strike the bell with this fork to break the loop!'

dungeons.name: The Beregost Clocktower Belfry
dungeons.theme: Vertical Clockwork Tower & Ground Zero of the Time Loop
dungeons.overview: The soaring 150-foot stone and brass clocktower standing at the center of Beregost's town square. Ground zero of the temporal loop. At 05:59 AM, the bone wedges the escapement gear; at 06:00 AM, the bone dissolves and the loop begins. At 18:00 PM, the solar orbital beam focuses directly through the tower's quartz crystal belfry, incinerating all reality and triggering the reset.

key_relics.name: The Great Escapement Gear
key_relics.desc: Giant 20-foot bronze cogwheel that governs the flow of local time; inserting the bone or tuning fork alters timeline continuity.

key_relics.name: The Solstice Bronze Bell
key_relics.desc: Master bell whose strike at 06:00 AM echoes across all 380 hexes; can be rung with the Chronomancy Tuning Fork to shatter the loop.

key_relics.name: The Arcanist's Resonator Core
key_relics.desc: Subterranean battery in the tower basement where the Angel and Devil souls were originally inverted.

timed_hazards.desc: Loop Ground Zero. The clock is jammed at 05:59 AM. Removing the bone causes a 4d10 thunder bell strike and initiates the loop.
Normal Operation. Clockwork ticks with deafening precision. Bram works in lower workshop. Town square bustling below.
Overheating Cogwheels. Escapement gears expand and glow red-hot (2d8 fire damage to anyone touching them).
💥 TOTAL SOLAR DETONATION! The orbital solar incinerator focuses directly down through the belfry prism (100d10 radiant wipeout across valley).

rooms.name: Bellringer's Workshop & Ground Vestry
rooms.description: Workbenches littered with brass filings, magnifying loupes, calipers, and gear blueprints. Spare escapement wheels hang from oak beams.

monsters.name: Clockwork Watch Sentinels
monsters.desc: Constructs created by Bram to guard the tower from saboteurs.

rooms.hazard: Greased Floor Traps: Pressure plates trigger oil slicks on the entrance stairs (DC 13 Dex save or fall prone).
rooms.secrets: Bram's Journal: Notes that the bone found in the gears at 05:59 AM was carved with celestial angelic runes—placed from the future!

rooms.name: Weight Shaft & Pendulum Chasm
rooms.description: A 90-foot vertical shaft through which two massive 4-ton lead counterweights rise and fall beside a swinging 30-foot brass pendulum.

monsters.name: Greater Air Elemental
monsters.desc: Trapped in the shaft by convective drafts; creates 40-foot updrafts.

rooms.hazard: Swinging Pendulum: Climbing the iron ladder requires DC 14 Dex save every 30 feet to avoid being clipped by the pendulum (4d8 bludgeoning).
rooms.secrets: Maintenance Niche: A small hatch at the 45-foot mark contains 3 Potions of Flying and a Feather Fall token.

rooms.name: The Escapement Gear Train
rooms.description: A dizzying labyrinth of interlocking bronze, iron, and silver gears 15 feet in diameter, churning with rhythmic CLACK-CLACK-CLACK cadence.

monsters.name: Arcane Clockwork Spiders
monsters.desc: Constructs that repair damaged cogs; spin conductive brass wire webs.

rooms.hazard: Grinding Teeth: Getting caught between interlocking gears deals 6d10 crushing damage (DC 16 Dex check to avoid).
rooms.secrets: ⭐ The Escapement Slot: The exact gear tooth where the party pulled the bone at 05:59 AM. Inserting the Chronomancy Tuning Fork here locks the gears!

rooms.name: The Crown Belfry & Solstice Chronometer
rooms.description: An open-air belfry overlooking the entire town square. In the center hangs the colossal 10-ton Bronze Bell, crowned by a focusing quartz prism.

monsters.name: The Singing Devil (True Final Boss)
monsters.desc: CR 14 Master Boss. The Angel's radiant form corrupted by the Devil's soul; channels Blinding Radiance, Hellfire Song, and Time Stop.

rooms.hazard: 18:00 Orbital Beam Convergence: Every round after 17:50 PM, radiant energy builds, dealing 2d10 radiant damage at start of turn.
rooms.secrets: ⭐ Shattering the Loop: Striking the bell with the Chronomancy Tuning Fork while chanting the Inversion Words reverses the soul swap, cleanses both beings, and halts the solar incinerator!

dungeons.name: Ash Grove & The Elder Weirwood
dungeons.theme: Sacred Blood-Red Weirwood Grove & Druidic Execution Ring
dungeons.boss_name: Horned Fiend (The True Angel) & Druid Circle
dungeons.overview: Deep in the northern briarwood forest stands Ash Grove, a clearing centered around an ancient weeping weirwood tree with bleeding red sap. At 06:15 AM, the True Angel (trapped in the Horned Fiend's body) crash-lands here after escaping the arcanist's battery. Archdruid Malakor and his circle believe it is an archdevil corrupting the forest. At 11:30 AM, their binding execution triggers a catastrophic soul detonation (70 radiant/fire damage across 300 feet), wiping out the grove!

key_relics.name: Celestial Tears of the Horned Fiend
key_relics.desc: Pure radiant tears wept by the fiend; confirms the beast has an angelic soul and acts as a potion of Supreme Healing.

key_relics.name: Elder Weirwood Sap
key_relics.desc: Bleeding crimson resin that grants immunity to fire damage for 2 hours.

key_relics.name: Archdruid Malakor's Oak Staff
key_relics.desc: Staff of the Woodlands; allows speaking with plants and commanding the briar wall to open.

timed_hazards.desc: Fiend Crash-Landing. A smoking crater opens in the clearing as the Horned Fiend crash-lands, bleeding white-silver ozone ichor.
Druidic Encirclement. Archdruid Malakor's circle surrounds the clearing, erecting a 20-foot wall of razor thorns.
The Binding Chant. Druids begin the solar purging ritual. The Horned Fiend thrashes in agonizing agony.
💥 DEAFENING SOUL DETONATION! The Horned Fiend is executed; its trapped angelic soul detonates in a 300-foot blast (70 radiant/fire dmg, heard across all hexes!).

rooms.name: The Razor Briar Perimeter & Thorny Thicket
rooms.description: A dense wall of tangled blackthorn and blood-brambles 20 feet high. Thorns 3 inches long drip with acidic green sap.

monsters.name: Briarwood Displacer Beast
monsters.desc: Sentinels guarding the outer perimeter; attack any who approach the grove without druid markings.

rooms.hazard: Razor Thorns: Forcing through the briars deals 4d6 piercing and DC 13 Con save or poisoned for 1 hour. Can be burned with fire or pacified by Speak with Plants.
rooms.secrets: Druid Scout Cache: Hollow oak trunk containing 3 vials of Antitoxin and a Cloak of Elvenkind.

rooms.name: The Scorched Clearing & Ozone Crater
rooms.description: A 60-foot smoking impact crater in the center of the mossy forest floor. Soil is vitrified into black glass, and silver-white glowing ichor trails lead toward the ancient tree.

monsters.name: Elder Redwood Owlbear
monsters.desc: CR 3 beast spooked by the crash; aggressively defends its scorched territory.

rooms.hazard: Ozone Arcs: Electrical arcs discharge from the crater every 3 rounds (DC 13 Dex save or 2d8 lightning damage).
rooms.secrets: ⭐ Celestial Ichor: Smelling or examining the silver ichor (DC 12 Arcana/Religion) reveals it is not fiendish blood—it smells of frankincense and ozone, the hallmark of a high Solar Angel!

rooms.name: Archdruid Malakor's Binding Circle
rooms.description: Twelve standing stones carved with nature runes surround the clearing. Six druids in antler masks channel crackling green and golden lightning into iron chains.

monsters.name: Druid Circle Channelers
monsters.desc: Channeling the execution ritual; will defend the circle to the death unless persuaded.

rooms.hazard: Binding Lightning: Touching the chains connecting the standing stones deals 3d10 lightning damage (DC 14 Dex save for half).
rooms.secrets: Malakor's Journal: Notes that Aurelius personally visited the grove at 07:00 AM, warning that the horned beast would destroy the forest unless executed by 11:30 AM.

rooms.name: The Heartwood Altar of the Elder Weirwood
rooms.description: An immense weirwood tree whose carved face weeps scarlet sap. Bound against its trunk in thorns is the terrifying Horned Fiend—its eyes streaming with pure glowing celestial tears.

monsters.name: Horned Fiend (The True Angel)
monsters.desc: CR 11 Boss. Trapped in fiendish flesh; speaks Celestial in telepathic cries: 'They do not know! The deceiver wears the sun!'

rooms.hazard: 11:30 AM Soul Detonation: If killed or executed by the Druids, the angelic soul detonates, dealing 70 radiant/fire damage and wiping out everything in Hex (7,6).
rooms.secrets: ⭐ Parley in Celestial: Speaking Celestial halts the combat! The True Angel reveals: 'The tiger fiend in the north wears my holy flesh! I am trapped in this beast! You must find the Inversion Tablets in the southern sands to break this curse!'

adult_white_dragon.name: Adult White Dragon (Rimefang)
adult_white_dragon.speed: 40 ft., burrow 30 ft., fly 80 ft., swim 40 ft.
adult_white_dragon.senses: Blindsight 60 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., Passive Perception 21

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.desc: The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost extra movement.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace the Bite attack with Cold Breath if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Cold damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 54 (12d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

bonus_actions.name: Glacial Roar
bonus_actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature within 60 ft. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

reactions.name: Tail Swipe
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature within 10 ft hits the dragon with a melee attack. Response: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or have the Prone condition.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Attack (Costs 1 Action)
legendary_actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

legendary_actions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19, creatures within 10 ft. Failure: 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage and knocked Prone. The dragon flies up to half its fly speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

adult_white_dragon.counter: The Rime-Anchor Harpoon at Hex (15,6) completely eliminates its 80ft Fly speed on hit. Drake-Bane Censer at (14,7) imposes Disadvantage on all its attack rolls. Slaying Rimefang frees Djinni Zephyrus (1 Wish/loop)!

mummy_lord.name: Mummy Lord (Akh-en-Amon)
mummy_lord.immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The mummy lord has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.desc: If the mummy lord fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: A destroyed mummy lord gains a new body in 24 hours unless its Canopic Heart in the Sunken Crypt is destroyed by fire or holy salt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mummy lord uses Dreadful Glare and makes one Rotting Fist attack.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage. Target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with Mummy Rot (cannot regain HP; hit point maximum drops by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours).

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature within 60 ft that can see the mummy lord. Failure: The target has the Frightened and Paralyzed conditions until the end of the mummy lord's next turn.

actions.name: Chronomantic Spells (DC 17)
actions.desc: At will: Hold Person, Silence. 2/day: Insect Plague (6d10 piercing), Harm (14d6 necrotic), Dispel Magic.

reactions.name: Sand Shield
reactions.desc: Trigger: The mummy lord is hit by an attack roll. Response: Swirling sand grants the mummy lord +4 to AC against that attack.

legendary_actions.name: Whirlwind of Sand (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The mummy lord magically transforms into a whirlwind of sand, moves up to 40 ft without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and reverts.

legendary_actions.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, creatures within 30 ft. Failure: 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage and Stunned until end of next turn.

mummy_lord.counter: Scarab of Solar Resurgence at Hex (13,14) gives Necrotic Immunity (blocks Mummy Rot). Sunburst Oil at (12,13) deals 4d6 fire + 2d6/rd (double to fire) and suppresses Legendary Actions. Smashing heart yields Inversion Tablets!

rakshasa_ravana.name: Lord Ravana / 'Aurelius the Radiant'
rakshasa_ravana.vulnerabilities: Piercing from magical weapons wielded by good-aligned creatures (Takes Double Damage!)
rakshasa_ravana.immunities: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from nonmagical attacks
rakshasa_ravana.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Truesight 60 ft., Passive Perception 18

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.desc: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of level 6 or lower unless it wishes to be. It has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The rakshasa makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus cursed wounds: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 18 or the target cannot benefit from Short or Long Rests until the curse is lifted by Remove Curse.

actions.name: Deceptive Spellcasting (DC 18)
actions.desc: At will: Disguise Self, Detect Thoughts, Minor Illusion. 3/day each: Charm Person, Invisibility, Major Image, Suggestion. 1/day each: Dominate Person, Fly, Plane Shift, True Seeing.

bonus_actions.name: Illusory Shift
bonus_actions.desc: The rakshasa shifts between 'Aurelius the Radiant' and his tiger guise, or teleports up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space it can see.

reactions.name: Misdirection
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature within 30 ft targets the rakshasa with an attack. Response: The rakshasa redirects the attack to a charmed ally within 5 ft of the attacker.

rakshasa_ravana.counter: Quiver of the Just Stalker at Hex (7,4) deals double piercing damage and ignores Limited Magic Immunity! Monocle of Piercing Truth at (8,6) pierces illusions. Look for inverted backwards hands at North Road Shrine (07:00)!

storm_giant_otheus.name: Tempest Lord Otheus (Storm Giant)

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The giant can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two Greatsword attacks or two Lightning Strike attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 30 (6d6 + 9) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +14, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 35 (4d12 + 9) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Lightning Strike (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, point within 500 ft, 10-foot radius. Failure: 54 (12d8) Lightning damage and Blinded until end of next turn. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Innate Magic (DC 17)
actions.desc: At will: Levitate, Light. 3/day: Control Weather, Water Breathing.

reactions.name: Rock Catching
reactions.desc: Trigger: A rock or similar projectile is hurled at the giant. Response: DC 10 Dexterity save; on success, the giant catches the missile and takes 0 damage.

storm_giant_otheus.counter: Chained underwater by 3 Abyssal Anchor Chains (AC 19, 50 HP each). Grounding Rod Trident at Hex (4,11) safely absorbs his lightning and breathes underwater. Freeing him unlocks the 17:30 Category-5 Storm Shield!

horned_fiend_angel.name: Horned Fiend (The True Angel)
horned_fiend_angel.size_type: Large Celestial (in Fiend Form), Lawful Good
horned_fiend_angel.resistances: Cold; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the creature's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The creature has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Pulls Punches (Merciful Soul)
traits.desc: Chooses to deal non-lethal damage on melee strikes; knocks targets stably unconscious instead of killing.

traits.name: Celestial Rejection Resonance
traits.desc: If executed with the Crucible Charm, its divine celestial soul detonates at 11:30 AM (70 radiant/fire damage region-wide), obliterating the grove and restarting the loop.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The horned celestial makes three attacks: two with its Fork and one with its Tail, or uses Hurl Radiant Flame twice.

actions.name: Fork
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Hurl Radiant Flame
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 150 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) Radiant/Fire damage.

reactions.name: Divine Shield
reactions.desc: Trigger: An ally or downed innocent within 10 ft is targeted by an attack. Response: Grants the target +5 to AC against that attack and absorbs half the damage.

horned_fiend_angel.counter: DO NOT ATTACK! Speaking Celestial or casting Calm Emotions breaks the druids' frenzied hunt and initiates peaceful dialogue. The True Angel reveals the body swap and details of the Singing Devil!

singing_devil_angel.name: The Singing Devil (in Angel's Body)
singing_devil_angel.size_type: Large Fiend (usurping Celestial Deva form), Lawful Evil
singing_devil_angel.resistances: Cold; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Discordant Resonance
traits.desc: While the Singing Devil sings, any non-fiend within 30 ft has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If it fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Makes three attacks: two with its Radiant Hellfire Greatsword and uses one Choral Dirge.

actions.name: Radiant Hellfire Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) Radiant or Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Choral Dirge
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 19, creatures within 60 ft. Failure: 22 (4d10) Psychic/Thunder damage and Frightened for 1 minute.

actions.name: Chronocite Ray (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19, 120-foot line. Failure: 55 (10d10) Force damage and target is temporally displaced (Incapacitated until start of next turn).

bonus_actions.name: Angelic Wing Feint
bonus_actions.desc: Flaps its corrupted feathered wings, disengaging and flying up to 30 ft without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

reactions.name: Parrying Chorus
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature within 5 ft makes a melee attack against it. Response: Adds +5 to its AC against that attack.

legendary_actions.name: Choral Blast (Costs 1 Action)
legendary_actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +11, range 60 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Thunder damage.

legendary_actions.name: Planar Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Teleports up to 60 ft to an unoccupied space.

legendary_actions.name: Harmonic Rupture (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19, 20-foot radius. Failure: 28 (8d6) Radiant/Hellfire damage.

singing_devil_angel.counter: At 17:30, Otheus deflects the solar beam with a Category-5 storm. Sunder the Devil's feathered wings while the rescued True Angel chants the Inversion Reversal Rite from the Alabaster Tablets, swapping their souls back and shattering the resonator!

stone_giant.name: Stone Giant Guardian

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.desc: Has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two Greatclub attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or have the Prone condition.

reactions.name: Rock Catching
reactions.desc: Trigger: A rock or similar projectile is hurled at the giant. Response: DC 10 Dexterity save; on success, the giant catches the projectile and takes 0 damage.

stone_giant.counter: Oreg the Carver at (12,6) is non-hostile if gifted shiny gems or dwarven beer. The cliff guardian at (15,6) guards the Rime-Anchor Harpoon.

winter_wolf.name: Winter Wolf Pack Leader

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The wolf has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one ally is within 5 ft of the creature.

traits.name: Snow Camouflage
traits.desc: The wolf has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage. Target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or have the Prone condition.

actions.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, 15-foot Cone. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

winter_wolf.counter: Guards the Boots of the Winter Strider at Hex (18,9). Weak to fire damage; scattering ignited oil breaks the pack formation.

air_elemental.name: Greater Air Elemental
air_elemental.resistances: Lightning, Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from nonmagical attacks
air_elemental.condition_immunities: Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Air Form
traits.desc: Can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. Can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Whirlwind (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in the elemental's space. Failure: 15 (3d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage and flung 20 ft away, knocked Prone. Success: Half damage and not flung.

air_elemental.counter: Throwing cold-iron into the vortex funnel disrupts its cohesion. Guards the Scarab of Solar Resurgence at Hex (13,14).

basilisk.name: Prismatic Basilisk

traits.name: Petrifying Gaze
traits.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature that starts its turn within 30 ft. Failure: Restrained and begins turning to stone. Repeats save at end of next turn: success ends effect, failure causes Petrified condition.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

basilisk.counter: Averted gaze gives Disadvantage on attacks but avoids petrification. Mirrors (or Golden Mirror-Aegis) reflect gaze back at basilisk! Guards Monocle of Piercing Truth at Hex (8,6).

owlbear.name: Elder Redwood Owlbear

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.desc: The owlbear has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Makes one Beak attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage.

owlbear.counter: Lairs in hollow redwood tree at Hex (7,4). Feeding it fresh venison or casting Animal Friendship (DC 13) allows bypassing it without combat to claim the Quiver of the Just Stalker.

displacer_beast.name: Briarwood Displacer Beast

traits.name: Displacement
traits.desc: Attack rolls against the beast have Disadvantage. If the beast takes damage, this trait is disrupted until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Avoidance
traits.desc: If the beast is subjected to an effect that allows a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage on success, and half on failure.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Makes two Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Piercing damage.

displacer_beast.counter: Magic Missile or AoE spell automatically hits to strip displacement defense. Guards the Circlet of Mind Sanctity at Hex (9,7).

abominable_yeti.name: Abominable Yeti of Frostpeak

traits.name: Fear of Fire
traits.desc: If the yeti takes fire damage, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Chilling Presence
traits.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 ft of the yeti takes 10 (3d6) Cold damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Makes two Claw attacks and can use Chilling Gaze.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Cold damage.

actions.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, 30-foot Cone. Failure: 45 (10d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Chilling Gaze
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, target within 30 ft. Failure: Paralyzed for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

abominable_yeti.counter: Lairs at Hex (16,11). Fire damage terrifies it and shuts down its multiattack advantage. Hoards frozen treasure chest.

giant_scorpion.name: Giant Dune Scorpion

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Makes three attacks: two with its Claws and one with its Sting.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage, and target is Grappled (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Piercing damage, and target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) Poison damage on a failure, or half on success.

giant_scorpion.counter: Burrows beneath sand dunes at Hex (15,15). Stepping lightly or flying bypasses its tremorsense.

green_hag.name: Auntie Murk (Green Hag)

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: Can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting (DC 12)
traits.desc: At will: Dancing Lights, Minor Illusion, Vicious Mockery.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Illusory Appearance
actions.desc: Covers herself with a magical illusion that has her look like a human traveler.

bonus_actions.name: Invisible Passage
bonus_actions.desc: Magically turns Invisible until she attacks or casts a spell, or until concentration ends.

green_hag.counter: Lairs in sunken barge at Hex (6,13). Can be bartered with using rare swamp herbs for secrets regarding the south sunken canal.

sea_harpy.name: Siren Sea Harpy

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Makes two attacks: one with its Claws and one with its Club.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Luring Song
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, each Humanoid within 300 ft. Failure: Charmed and compelled to move into deep surf toward the rocks.

sea_harpy.counter: Stuffing ears with wax or casting Silence negates the song completely. Roosts at Hex (3,11).

galeb_duhr.name: Galeb Duhr Elder
galeb_duhr.resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from nonmagical attacks
galeb_duhr.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., Passive Perception 11

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While motionless, indistinguishable from an ordinary boulder.

traits.name: Rolling Charge

solstice_prophecy_poem.text:
With six chimes the belfry wakes,
The choir sings, the mountain shakes.

Slay the white wyrm for his chart,
To claim a wish of frozen heart.

South: sunken tombs of sand reveal
Two traded souls a touch must heal.

North: pierce the striped fiend’s holy guise,
His true name binds his web of lies.

West: break the deep-sea giant’s chain,
To drag the singing wings to rain.

Four corners mend the falling sun,
Or dawn resets what dusk begun.
solstice_prophecy_poem.source: Old Jonas the Rhymer (Beregost Municipal Well)
solstice_prophecy_poem.significance: Cryptic 12-line roadmap to stopping the 18:00 PM solar cataclysm
